title: 第一卷 第21章 他是谁？
content_zh:
韩汐眼眸微颤。

    她只是一个被自己的父亲，为了与秦绝缓和关系，这才送入秦府的牺牲品而已啊，重要的事，岂能交付于她？

    韩汐轻吸一口气，欠身道：“还请少爷吩咐。”

    不管是什么事，以她现在的身份，都没有资格拒绝，哪怕是那种事……

    秦绝笑道：“你父亲说你是操持内务的一把好手，我也瞧得见，你是个秀外慧中、心细如尘的好姑娘，只可惜，我秦府萧条，暂时没什么内务可以让你操持的。但秦家产业，如今已经尽数归回，而我需要修炼，无暇去管这些。所以我想让你替我去经营秦家名下的所有产业，你可愿意？”

    韩汐一双明眸，不由惊瞪，随即慌忙跪地道：“少爷，这使不得。汐儿就是来伺候您的，更是从未涉足经营之道。少爷若真是需要有人代管秦家产业，可以发榜招募这方面的人才。汐儿年浅，也无足够才能，着实不敢胜任。”

    秦绝淡笑道：“这可是你摆脱被家族支配命运的大好机会，你当真不要？你若成了我秦家的管事人，这凤州城内，任何人都休想再欺负你半分，哪怕是你父亲，你爷爷，对你也要客气三分。”

    韩汐心中一颤，眼神也亮了几分。

    “机会不常有，如果碰上了，就要学会抓住。气运这个东西，很玄乎。抓住了一次，往后的气运，就会越来越强。错失了一次，便会越来越衰，因为错过，便会患得患失，一旦心境乱了，前路也就断了。”

    “你好好想想，想好了，再来给我答复。”

    秦绝笑了笑，将茶饮一口饮尽，把碗放回韩汐手中。

    韩汐双手握紧着茶碗，像是捧着一副千斤重担。

    她猛地抬头看向秦绝，这一刻她的目光里，满是放着光芒的坚毅！

    “少爷，汐儿愿意一试！”

    秦绝的话，犹如醍醐灌顶，激起了韩汐心中的不甘，还有勇气！

    秦绝一笑：“不错，那便放手去做吧，不必计较暂时的盈亏。人手不够，你就招募。”

    说着，秦绝取出一枚储物戒，递给韩汐：“这枚储物戒中，有二十万灵石，不够再说。”

    韩汐低吸一口气！

    二十万灵石！

    即便她是韩家的五小姐，长这么大，也从来没有握过这么一大笔灵石！

    “多谢少爷，汐儿定当努力，报答少爷这份信任！”韩汐郑重接过储物戒。

    “走吧，带你去各处转上一圈，认个眼熟，之后便可少去一些麻烦。”秦绝起身来。

    如果没有秦绝亲自领着，韩汐这么一个看起来很柔弱的小姑娘，未必能够顺利接管所有产业。

    秦家原本就有十七处产业，加上韩家送的三处产业，以及从谢家夺来的十处产业，现在共计三十处产业。
content_en:
Han tide's eyes trembled slightly.

    She was just a victim sent to the Qin Mansion by her father in order to ease the relationship with Qin Jue. How could he leave important things to her?

    Han tide took a breath, leaned forward and said, "Please give me your instructions, Master."

    No matter what it is, with her current status, she is not qualified to refuse, even if it is that kind of thing...

    Qin Jue smiled and said: "Your father said that you are a good hand in managing internal affairs, and I can see that you are a good girl with a delicate appearance and a thoughtful heart. Unfortunately, my Qin Mansion is in depression, and there is no internal affairs for you to take care of for the time being. But the Qin family's properties have now been returned, and I need to practice and have no time to take care of them. So I want you to manage all the properties under the Qin family's name for me. Are you willing?"

    Han tide's bright eyes couldn't help but stare in shock, and then he hurriedly knelt down and said: "Master, this is impossible. Xi'er is here to serve you, and has never been involved in business. If the master really needs someone to take care of the Qin family's property, he can recruit talents in this field. Xi'er is young and does not have enough talent, so he is really not qualified for the job."

    Qin Jue smiled lightly and said: "This is a great opportunity for you to get rid of the fate of being dominated by your family. Do you really don't want it? If you become the steward of my Qin family, no one in Fengzhou City can even think of bullying you. Even your father and grandfather must be polite to you."

    Han tide's heart trembled, and his eyes brightened a little.

    "Opportunities don't come often. If you encounter them, you must learn to seize them. Luck is a mysterious thing. If you seize it once, your luck will become stronger and stronger in the future. If you miss it once, your luck will become weaker and weaker. Because if you miss it, you will worry about gains and losses. Once your mind is confused, the way forward will be blocked."

    "Think about it carefully, and then give me an answer after you think about it."

    Qin Jue smiled, drank the tea in one gulp, and put the bowl back into Han tide's hand.

    Han tide held the tea bowl tightly with both hands, as if he was holding a heavy burden.

    She suddenly raised her head and looked at Qin Jue. At this moment, her eyes were full of radiant perseverance!

    "Master, Xi'er is willing to give it a try!"

    Qin Jue's words were like enlightenment, arousing Han tide's unwillingness and courage!

    Qin Jue smiled: "Yes, then just go ahead and do it, don't worry about temporary profits and losses. If there are not enough people, just recruit."

    With that said, Qin Jue took out a storage ring and handed it to Han tide: "There are 200,000 spirit stones in this storage ring. It's not enough."

    Han tide took a deep breath!

    Two hundred thousand spirit stones!

    Even though she is the fifth young lady of the Han family, she has never held such a large amount of spiritual stones in her entire life!

    "Thank you, Master. Xi'er will work hard to repay the trust of Master!" Han tide solemnly took the storage ring.

    "Let's go, I'll take you around for a while and make sure you look familiar. Then you'll have less trouble." Qin Jue stood up.

    Without Qin Jue's personal leadership, a weak-looking girl like Han tide might not be able to successfully take over all the properties.

    The Qin family originally had seventeen properties, plus the three properties given by the Han family and the ten properties taken from the Xie family, there are now a total of thirty properties.
